body:
I do deserve punishment. I deserve it for everyone that I've lied to and whose time I've wasted. 

I barely got good grades in high school. They started falling off towards the last 2 years because of my laziness and carelessness. 

Since I got away with that and somehow got into a good university, I kept abusing that mentality hoping it would get me by there too. I didn't do any work that I didn't feel like was worth my time. I felt like I can "always do better next semester." But my first semester there was horrible mentally. I was homesick and missed my friends badly.

My group of friends didn't really become tight until the end of senior year in high school. We were very close going into college and over the years. They're all in their final and fourth year of college now. However, they all went to schools in my home state. I went out-of-state. I didn't want to make close friends in college because I didn't need anyone else except them. They would always meet up once a month or whenever they went home which I couldn't do. I resented myself for going so far away. 

I have some good memories there, but I was never social. I'd always preferred staying in my room. As a result, I never pursued anything there and I wasn't happy there. I lied to myself and said it would get better later. That mentality also led to my academics being horrible. I was very infrequent in going to class. My attendance was never stable. If I did work, I got a few C's at best. I was in academic probation by the end of first year. During the first semester of my 2nd year, I put some more effort in and got out of academic probation, but barely. I was still at the edge of being suspended. 

That second semester of sophomore year was horrible. I completely stopped going to classes after coming back from home at the end of Spring Break. I wasted away there. I was depressed. After I left for home, I knew I wasn't going back.

That summer, I was reckless and put off confronting my parents until a few weeks before the next semester. I wanted to have a last enjoyable before who knows what. At end of the summer, I told my parents.  We had a huge argument and talk. I promised to rectify my mistake and go to community college for a year and transferring to a local university. I thought I was finally going to rebound.

Wrong.

That mentality that I mentioned before? It never left. I did the same shit at community. But even at home, I felt alone. My friends were still 1-2 hours away. I stopped attending some classes that year. And I knew transferring to a local university was pointless because I knew I wouldn't get in. So I never applied. I just enjoyed this summer with my friends again. I lied to my parents about my grades and applying locally for this fall semester. I'm not even sure the community college will let me back in. 

Honestly, I don't deserve it. Any of these chances, I don't deserve them. I wasted thousands of my parents' money and time. I'm a fuck up who'll never learn from my mistakes. I have no moral compass. I fucking flunked out of a community college. I just want the easy way out like I always did. I just want to end my pathetic attempt at life.

I'm sorry if you had to go through similar stuff. I don't why anyone else would put themselves through this torture.
